# Project rules (generated by Harness; keep short)

- Stack: python
- Verify before claiming done. Commands:
  - unit: `python3 -m pytest -q`
  - lint: `ruff check .`
  - typecheck: `mypy .`
- Never edit protected paths: .env*, *.pem, id_rsa*, secrets/**
- Work only inside the task worktree; never push to main/master.
- Done = all gates in the task contract (.ai-engineering/tasks/) pass, not 'looks right'.
